about_the_game:
Embark on Foxxel's journey!

Winter is coming, and Foxxel needs a hood! But getting one won't be easy...

Explore 8 unique settings and conquer 80 challenging levels! From enchanted forests to dark caves, each environment introduces new puzzles that build upon each other throughout the game, ensuring a constantly innovative experience.

Each scenario brings a fresh challenge!

✔ Push stones to clear paths

✔ Connect lasers to the correct braziers

✔ Use reflectors to redirect lasers

And much more! New mechanics to challenge you. Solve puzzles in the desert, the city, and even the North Pole! ❄️

Autoplay Available!

If a level proves too difficult, watch the step-by-step solution to learn how to solve it.

Achievements

30 Steam achievements to unlock throughout the journey!

Charming pixel art, with a lighthearted and comical story, and a cozy soundtrack to accompany the adventure.

Foxxel Quest is a game that challenges your reasoning and warms your heart! Are you ready for this journey?

Found a translation error? Let us know! We want everyone to play Foxxel Quest. Your language isn't available? Get in touch! We appreciate your support!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo / AMD Athlon X2 or higher
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any with OpenGL 2.0+ support
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 4th Gen / AMD Ryzen 3 or higher
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD Radeon HD 7770 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Foxxel Quest is a cute and challenging pixel art puzzle game! Help Foxxel find a warm hood while solving 80 unique puzzle levels. Each setting brings a new challenge that builds upon each other throughout the game. With 30 achievements and optional autoplay, it's fun for all ages!
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Indonesian, Japanese, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish, Korean
